The message type of the topic to monitor for OOF messages.
This parameter supports regular expressions.
There is no default for this parameter.

Set the filter to apply.
This filter forms the internal subscription for which OOF messages
will be generated.

The type of OOF message to take action on:
match - take action on OOF messages generated because
message no longer matches filter.
delete - take action on OOF messages generated because
message has been removed from the SOW.
expire - take action on OOF messages generated because the
message expired from the SOW.
all - take action on all of the above types.
Default: all
